## generatedName() function

A generated custom property name.

Generated names are stable for a given source file and namespace so that separate builds produce the same output. They are also recognisable, so that generated properties are never processed a second time.

Callers may append another custom property name to the result, which keeps the result a valid custom property name.

**Signature:**

```typescript

```
